data.plainLyric:
오랜만이야 잘 지낸 거니
여전히 눈이 부셔 넌
아마도 너는 잘 모를 거야
All of the memories
All of the moments
Come rushing back

전해 들었어
네 옆엔 아직 그 사람이 있다고
I see it in your eyes
That you need me by your side
And I can't walk away
Cause love ain't supposed to be a riddle

You deserve someone that loves you right
Baby you deserve better
I could love you til the end of time
Baby you deserve better
Better oh better
Baby you deserve better

겨울을 덮어준 너의 봄
여름 바람이 돼주던 너의 손
어부바해서 집까지
Butterfly라며 꽃까지
동화 같아 돌아보니까 Never
구름처럼 띄워 줬을까 매번
결국 비는 내리고 난 우산이 없네
찬란했던 계절 속에 빛은 어디로

전해 들었어
네 옆엔 아직 그 사람이 있다고
I see it in your eyes
That you need me by your side
And I can't walk away
Cause love ain't supposed to be a riddle

You deserve someone that loves you right
Baby you deserve better
I could love you til the end of time
Baby you deserve better
Better oh better
Baby you deserve better

So wherever you go
Whoever you meet
Just remember me
Cause every time I look into your eyes
My heart won't let me lie
Oh baby one thing I need you to know
Baby you deserve better

You deserve someone that loves you right
Baby you deserve better
I could love you til the end of time
Baby you deserve better
